in_marathi.name: Boudhayan
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Wise, intelligent, scholarly
in_marathi.long_meaning: Boudhayan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Boudhayan is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Bodh', meaning 'to wake up' or 'to enlighten'. The suffix 'ayan' means 'one who leads' or 'one who has knowledge'. This name is often given to a child who is expected to become a wise and knowledgeable leader in the future.
